message.content:
**Battle of Waterloo – Casualty Figures**

| Category | Approximate Numbers |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Killed / Died** | 5 500–7 000 soldiers (British & allies) + 8 800–10 200 French‑aligned troops ≈ **14 300–17 200** |
| **Wounded** | Roughly 12 000–15 000 allied forces + 20 000–22 000 French‐side ≈ **32 000–37 000** |
| **Missing / Captured** | About 1 400–2 000 allied + 3 000–4 000 French side ≈ **4 400–6 000** |

### Total Combined Casualties  
Adding all categories gives an estimated **≈ 40 700–50 200** combatants affected at Waterloo.  

> *Note:* Exact counts vary among historians because records were incomplete and some bodies were never recovered. Most modern scholarship cites roughly **30 000–35 000** killed or mortally wounded and another **70 000–80 000** injured or captured when including non-combatant losses such as civilians displaced during the campaign.
